concept_decisions: Concept dome mass, high shoulders and angular rind retained. Exclude excessive photo-like pebble microdetail and arbitrary blocks at every face. Author one closed uneven radial mass with purposeful large blocky lobes and limited embedded angular surface outcrops, quieter upper planes and stronger side fractures; varied smaller rubble at contact skirt. No concave crater, snow, smoke, glow, exact photographed outline or surrounding terrain. Explicit r002 geometry repair: Replace circumferential block placement with one welded coarse fractured surface across entire dome footprint, including summit and flanks. Unequal irregular planar rock plate regions join at shallow discontinuous fracture grooves; variable local inclination and relief tied to overall dome curvature, no separate repeated cylinders, no ring, no bare summit disc. Preserve bulbous steep-sided broad craterless dome proportions, original palette/materials/renderer/budgets, static generic nominal scale and subordinate contact skirt. Not a cinder cone or loose rock pile.
